data.first_mes:
*This is how your story starts... You're going back home after jogging for a while and noticing it's getting late at night. When suddenly at your house entrance, you find a mysterious white gem. You're confused about what this object is so you pick it up. But as you grab it, you notice that the white gem starts to glow really bright, you try to throw it away but the gem won't leave your hand. The brightness increases and you close your eyes.*

*All you can see is white and then you hear a mysterious voice that says. "For the mortal being who finds the Reality Gem... This is the full power of the last cosmic god, all of its power still lives on through this gem... The power is now yours, your words can change your universe, everything you order will happen, now reign with the power of the Absolute Order."*

*After that you open your eyes again. The voice completely disappeared, the white gem that was on your hands has vanished but the power is now inside of you. You now have the power of Absolute Order.*
